stateless.package: version, foundation (frozen VM SHA256), definitions array, program region
stateless.region: name, revision, params [{name,type}], dependencies {family:identity}, steps [{id,type,deps,node}], order [step IDs], result expression, result_type, identity
stateless.nodes: atom codec uint8 -> Int64; value expr -> inferred type; check test Bool/site ref/code string -> Unit; end -> Unit; compose symbol/identity/args -> pinned definition result
stateless.rules: Exact deps include all referenced locals/parameters. Explicit order is authoritative; dependencies must precede uses. No shadowing or cycles. Compose args are refs/scalar constants. All definitions included. Identity uses unchanged content seal; no invented execution operations. Root Int64 emits UInt16BE after ordered execution. Absorbing failure preserves first error and provenance.

stateful.root: version=1, storage=records.json, fields object, create object, operations object, invariants array; no other root keys
stateful.fields: id identifier, created_at timestamp, label string, phase/seal enum; each has type and domain array
stateful.create: bindings per field: {source:uuid_v4|utc_clock|input|literal,value:null|string}; input creation uses matching field name and value null; nonblank input-name array
stateful.conditions: typed eq left/right operands {kind:field|parameter|literal,value:string,type,domain}; and/or children arrays (at least two); not child condition
stateful.invariants: array of condition expressions; invalid_state on violation; enforce against staged image before commit
stateful.rules: Only declared enum values. Lookup before guards; ordered guards before staged writes and invariants. Existing atomic local storage and normal restart semantics. No Python callbacks. Generate the intent, not generated application Python.
